frontal_spatial_matrix.muzzle_spot_diameter: Individual spot diameter is significantly smaller than the nasal pad, occupying approximately 5-10% of the nasal pad's vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, elevated, greyish-blue nodular protrusion on the dorsal-posterior cranium; minor hair loss/abrasion on the nasal bridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, thick black transverse bar on the lateral neck.
